card.name: Spot just before a time interval number
card.fires_on: The space or small word (every, than, on) right before a number of hours or days in dosing or timing text. It fires where a duration such as 24 hours or 12 hours is about to be written.

modes.label: Before dosing interval
modes.description: The gap after 'every' where an interval like 24 hours comes next.

modes.label: Before time to onset
modes.description: The gap after 'was' before a number of hours for median onset time.
